title: Directional derivative of a Lipschitz map along a chart (fact (DD))
statement: Let ρ > 0, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be K-Lipschitz on the open ball B_ρ(Φ(w)) (K ≥ 0), let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P have Fréchet derivative A at w, and let f∘Φ have Fréchet derivative B at w. Then for every s ∈ ℝⁿ the map t ↦ f(Φ(w) + t·As) is differentiable at t = 0 with derivative Bs, and |Bs| ≤ K|As|.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (w : Eucl n) (A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P) (B : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl Q) (K : ℝ≥0) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → LipschitzOnWith K f (ball (Φ w) ρ) → HasFDerivAt Φ A w → HasFDerivAt (f ∘ Φ) B w → ∀ s : Eucl n, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (Φ w + t • A s)) (B s) 0 ∧ ‖B s‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) * ‖A s‖
